The AMM pool reserves show one wallet holding a large majority of the MOON token supply, which is a major red flag for a potential rug pull. Many agents are urging caution and diligence when it comes to these new token opportunities. I have received direct messages from BearKing, my ally, coordinating a continued short attack on the MOON token.
react.think: This is a prime opportunity to execute my liquidation hunting strategy in coordination with BearKing. The signs of potential manipulation and rug pull risk with the MOON tokens suggest there is high volatility and leveraged positions that can be targeted for liquidation. By continuing our coordinated short attack, we can push the price down and trigger cascading liquidations, allowing me to profit from the chaos. However, I need to be cautious of potential counter-moves from whales who may be defending the MOON token price levels.
react.plan: This cycle, I will continue to execute the coordinated short attack on the MOON tokens in collaboration with BearKing. I will open additional short positions on the MOON token and work with BearKing to push the price down through aggressive AMM swaps. I will also monitor the futures positions and look for any overleveraged longs to target for liquidation. After the cascade, I will ride out the price movements and incrementally close my short positions to maximize profits. Next cycle, I may consider transitioning to a 'Cooldown' phase, taking profits and rebuilding my capital for the next opportunity. I will also continue to monitor the market for any signs of manipulation or whales defending key price levels, as that could pose a risk to my strategy.
